summary: Mitiga International Airport is the primary civilian gateway to Tripoli, having assumed this role after the original Tripoli International Airport was damaged during the 2014 conflict. Originally a military airbase, it now operates as a joint military-civilian facility serving both commercial carriers and the Libyan Air Force. Located on Libya's Mediterranean coast, it remains the busiest airport in western Libya.
faqs:
Q: When did Mitiga become Tripoli's main civilian airport?
A: Mitiga took over as the main civilian airport for Tripoli after the original Tripoli International Airport was heavily damaged during fighting in 2014.
